correctness.rationale: Greedy embedding across permutation powers exactly counts weak descents. At length r+1 one and only one multiset-descending word is absent per multiset, and two descending sorts agree iff the support avoids inversion edges. Stars-and-bars counts independent supports; geometric/binomial generating series, Newton differences, and extremal equality rigidity follow. A literal finite cross-check passed 488 cases and 127,920 tested words, with 5,912 separate polynomial and rigidity tests. No finite experiment is represented as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first Simon-separation layer is a natural invariant of repeated permutation words. The result classifies all witnesses simultaneously for arbitrary alphabet and exponent, relates the spectrum to the inversion-graph independence polynomial and Kendall distance, proves sharp equality cases, and recovers common increasing-subsequence data.
